notes: Continuous open-top conductive PP #1B1B1B, roughness 0.65; two real 70 x 22 mm short-wall finger openings centred at Z32 (chosen R6), nominal dimensions before the 1 mm edge roll. Original yellow ESD triangle/finger/spark and ESD SAFE screen print on -X. Five-piece collision is the mandated floor plus four walls, never a cavity-filling hull. This fixed convex-piece count cannot reproduce concave finger holes within the general 1 mm rule: the two holes are deliberately filled in the proxies. Each wall proxy is a convex strip clipped to the R8 outer outline; its inner plane is inset 0.5 mm into the cavity to keep the rounded corner seam error below 1 mm while retaining only four convex walls. The floor preserves its R8 outline with 56 vertices. Task 1 payloads are reused by scene assembly and are not rebuilt or embedded here. Friction 0.25 is the intended tray/rail sliding coefficient; use an explicit simulator contact pair if combining it with another material's coefficient. See the rail set's support-plane integration note. Metres, Z up, front -X, bottom-centre origin shared by every part and proxy. Triangulated OBJ with normals, 30-degree smoothing and nonoverlapping Smart UV 66-degree atlases. 64-sample CPU Cycles base colour * (0.4 + 0.6 * AO), saved as 8-bit sRGB, without lighting or highlights. Full Principled PBR, source markings and procedural wear remain packed in source.blend. Generated with Blender 5.2.0 LTS. Task 13 compact OBJ exception: positions use 5 decimal metres where safe; necessary vertices retain up to 6 decimals to preserve nonzero triangles, strict collision convexity and the 0.005 mm Euclidean movement bound. Independent fixed-5 rounding cannot satisfy all three. Normals/UVs use 4 decimals; every original triangle, position index and per-corner attribute value is retained. Equal rounded UV records share indices and visual OBJ indices use shorter equivalent relative notation. No collision remeshing, reindexing or simplification. Task 13 delivery: baked albedos are Lanczos-downsampled to at most 1024 px except the unchanged-resolution factory-floor repeat tile; previews are 512 square. PNG encoding uses RGB8 or reviewed 256-colour Floyd-Steinberg palettes; source artwork pixels and source.blend are retained. Shared PNG paths resolve from this prop folder.
